integrity: The principal claim is supported by a complete flag-count and subspace-Mobius proof plus independent small-field enumeration. Experimental checks are not used as infinite-dimensional proofs.
scientific_limitations: Labeled finite-field module-point counts, not conjugacy classes or variety components; all four products vanish; finite exhaustive checks only at specified small prime fields; external priority not independently certified.
title: Four-parameter rank and socle census for square-zero two-loop modules
